Package io.github.janglada.orkit

Interface Solution

All Known Implementing Classes:
BookingSolution, CuttingSolution, EmployeeRoster, JobShopSchedule, MultipleKnapsackSolution, PackingSolution, RoutingPlan
public interface Solution
The result of solving an OptimizationProblem: the solver status, the objective value reached, and how long the solve took.

Use isFeasible() and isOptimal() for the most common status checks.

      Duration runtime()

    • isFeasible

      default boolean isFeasible()
      Whether the solver produced a usable (optimal or merely feasible) solution.
      Returns:
      true if status() is SolveStatus.OPTIMAL or SolveStatus.FEASIBLE

    • isOptimal

      default boolean isOptimal()
      Whether the solver proved global optimality.

      For routing this is rarely true, because routing uses heuristics (first-solution strategies + local-search metaheuristics) rather than proving optimality; expect FEASIBLE there.

      Returns:
      true if status() is SolveStatus.OPTIMAL

    • diagnostics

      default SolveDiagnostics diagnostics()
      Search statistics for this result: best proven bound, branches, conflicts and, when requested, an explanation of infeasibility. SolveDiagnostics.none() by default.

    • bestBound

      default OptionalDouble bestBound()
      The best objective bound the solver proved, if any: no feasible solution can beat it. Empty for routing, for models without an objective, and when no solution was found.

    • gap

      default OptionalDouble gap()
      Relative optimality gap |objective - bound| / max(1, |objective|): 0 for a proven optimum, empty when either the objective or the bound is missing.
